subject: Thursday Executive Signal — Wins, Threats, and QBR Runbook
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Executive Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: marketplace-ops@gcp.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Thursday Executive Signal — Wins, Threats, and QBR Runbook

Team — quick weekly pulse heading into QBR prep. I kept this tight (wins, immediate risks, and concrete asks) so we can surface any blockers in today’s check-in. Please action items in-line.

WINS
- Hosted API throughput: 18% lower p99 tail vs. baseline after the kernel selection tweak; infra counted a stable 12% CPU reduction on pre-prod.
- Two mid-market conversions: OliveTech signed PO (see related HubSpot). Onboarding kickoff next week.
- Optimize suggestions: Optimize engine flagged 3 quantization candidates with projected 22% cost reduction; trials lined up.

RISKS / THREATS
- Billing delta: apparent 14% increase month-over-month for a subset of customers; root cause still unclear — potential mis-tagging of dedicated capacity.
- QBR artifacts: We do not yet have finalized SLA historical slides (last 6 months) for OliveTech; they requested the data by EOD Monday.
- Partner listing: GCP marketplace listing has a metadata mismatch that may delay co-sell incentives (cc: marketplace-ops).

ASKS (owners + due dates)
- Jonas: run the billing delta spike triage and confirm whether it's tagging vs. true usage. Deliverable: short RCA + rollback plan by 6/16 EOD.
- Marissa: assemble the OliveTech QBR pack (SLA charts, incident history, cost analysis). I’ve attached a template; need a draft by 6/16 11:00 AM PT for review.
- Kimberly: validate the Optimize recommendations for production readiness (knock-on regressions, eval prompts). Quick thumbs by 6/15 noon.
- Leadership: confirm whether we want to surface the 22% projected saving in the QBR narrative (risk: pre-production data).

Attachments: QBR_Runbook_v1.pdf (runbook template), Ops_Heatmap_Q2.csv (engine-level heatmap). Link to the working deck: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBR-Runbook-Redwood-Prep

If you cannot meet the due dates, flag here ASAP so I can reassign. I’ll schedule a 30-min runthrough tomorrow 10:30 AM PT — invite to follow.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Executive Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Thursday Executive Signal — Wins, Threats, and QBR Runbook

On Thu, 14 Jun 2028 at 08:22, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — quick weekly pulse heading into QBR prep. I kept this tight (wins, immediate risks, and concrete asks) so we can surface any blockers in today’s check-in.

Acknowledged. I’ll start with the billing logs (ingestion, tagging pipeline, and quota attribution). Early note: last ingestion job reattempted on 6/07 and we saw a short lived double-counting window for retries — may be related. Will confirm and share a short RCA by EOD 6/16.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:40:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Thursday Executive Signal — Wins, Threats, and QBR Runbook

Lauren — quick clarifying Qs: 
1) For the "billing delta" ask, do you want me to check model-level token accounting or broader request-level attribution? I can do both but want to prioritize.
2) On the Optimize suggestions: do you want a conservative note in the QBR (we tested on pre-prod only) or full projection with caveats?

Proposed: Marissa owns the QBR deck assembly; I’ll provide a 1-slide appendix on Optimize with explicit caveats. If you want the projection in the headline, we should add a one-line risk callout.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Executive Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.ai>, marketplace-ops@gcp.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 12:15:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Thursday Executive Signal — Wins, Threats, and QBR Runbook

Thanks — answers inline.

1) Jonas please prioritize request-level attribution first (so we can quickly tell which customers saw the delta). Kim, follow with model/token accounting as the second pass.
2) Include the Optimize projection in the appendix only; headline can call out "Evaluate potential 20–25% unit-cost reduction; seeing pre-prod gains — evaluation ongoing." Add the explicit caveat: "Pre-production results; production rollout TBD pending regressions checks."

Marissa — @you: draft the QBR pack using the attached runbook as structure. I need a draft by 6/16 11:00 AM PT (internal review). Also, include a short SLA timeline (incidents and uptimes) for OliveTech and a note on our upcoming private deployment option (customer interest).

I’m scheduling the prep call for 6/15 10:30 AM PT — calendar invite to follow.

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.ai

--
Attachment(s): QBR_Runbook_v1.pdf, Ops_Heatmap_Q2.csv
Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBR-Runbook-Redwood-Prep
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@olivetech.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thursday Executive Signal — Wins, Threats, and QBR Runbook

Hi Lauren / Marissa — thanks for the update and congrats on the performance improvements. OliveTech is excited to get the QBR materials. Two quick asks from our side:

- Can you include 6 months of SLA uptime and incident notes (we need this for our procurement/compliance team)?
- We’d also like a short note on data retention and KMS integrations for our security reviewers.

We are available for the prep call 6/15 10:30 AM PT. If you need any pre-reading, I can share our internal ops checklist.

Regards,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Platform Engineering | OliveTech
sarah.jenkins@olivetech.com
